Otako is the quiet loner of the class, but she is good friends with Galko. Ojou speaks her mind freely and naturally.

altTitles.en: The Dungeon, the Gal, and the Saga of the Lagging Heroic Explorer

description.en: Kaoru Kunou, a former legend known as the "Dungeon Maniac," is now, for certain reasons, a bottom-tier explorer. Though worn out by reality, he continues to chase the fleeting dreams and youth of his past. One day, by chance, he saves S-class gal streamer Shion from a crisis, and she falls for him at first sight. Initially flustered by Shion's overwhelmingly bright and charming advances, Kaoru gradually finds himself healed and drawn to her. Eventually, the two form a temporary mentor-student duo and set out to challenge the depths of a dungeon tied to their pasts, but what lies ahead!?
description.ja: 「ダンジョン狂い」の元レジェンド・久能薫流（くのうかおる）は、訳あって今は最底辺探索者。現実にくたびれ切りつつも夢と青春の尻尾を追い続ける彼は、ある日偶然にS級ギャル配信者・シオンの危機を救い、彼女に一目惚れされてしまう。底抜けに明るくて愛らしいシオンの猛アプローチに戸惑いながらも、次第に癒され、惹かれていくのを自覚する薫流。やがて仮の師弟コンビを組んだ二人は、因縁あるダンジョン深層に挑むことになるが！？

altTitles.ja: 今日もカフェななくさ日和

altTitles.en: Another Fine Day at Café Nanakusa
Another Great Day at Café Nanakusa

description.en:
“Thank you, Suzu. I'm glad you were here.”

Café Nanakusa, located at 793 Hakobera Town, Kogomi City, is a small café run by a kindhearted chef and his loyal brothers.

One snowy day, a young sheep named Suzu arrives at Nanakusa all alone, having left her family home. She has been struggling with the fact that she is the only member of her family who has never grown horns.

With the support of Shiro, the café's manager, who looks intimidating and seems cool at first glance but is actually very caring, Suzu begins to experience the warmth of the town's residents at Nanakusa and gradually discovers who she truly is.

Meanwhile, the townspeople, as well as Shiro himself, who came to Nanakusa carrying sorrow from his past, find themselves gaining strength from Suzu's earnest efforts, too.

This heartwarming story, sure to warm your heart as you read, is finally being released as a full-color book, much to the delight of its fans!

You won't be able to take your eyes off the slow-burn, heart-fluttering romance between the honest, innocent Suzu and Shiro, who is completely unprepared for the feeling of being lovestruck…!!!

From the café staff to the townspeople, every character has their own unique personality, so you're sure to find a favorite!

The book also features plenty of exclusive, newly drawn manga and illustrations. There's even a story about that popular character that you can only read in this book…!
description.ja:
「ありがとうな、すずがいてくれてよかったよ」

こごみ市はこべら町793番地にあるカフェななくさは、情に厚いシェフと義理堅い兄弟たちが営む小さなお店。
ある雪の降る日、ひとりななくさへやってきたのは、家族でひとりだけツノが生えてこないことに悩み、親元を離れた羊のすずだった。
一見強面でクールながら面倒見のよい店長のしろに支えられながら、すずはななくさで街の住人のあたたかさに触れ、少しずつ“自分”を見つけていく。
そして街の住人や、過去に悲しみを抱えてななくさへやってきたしろもまた、すずの一生懸命な姿に元気をもらっていて――。
読めば心があたたかくなる物語が、ファン待望のフルカラー書籍化！

素直で無邪気なすずと、ときめき耐性ゼロのしろのじれきゅん恋模様からも目が離せない...！！！
カフェメンバーをはじめ、街の住人もみんな個性的で自分の推しキャラが見つかること間違いなし！
書籍限定描き下ろしまんがやイラストも多数掲載。この書籍でしか読めない、あの人気キャラのお話も...！

description.en: A daily life with an eccentric bug
description.pt-br: O dia a dia com um inseto excêntrico

description.en:
Seth is an apprentice sorcerer from the Pompo Hills. Like all sorcerers, he's an "infected", one of the few people having survived an encounter with a Nemesis, those creatures falling from the sky and destroying everything around them. Being immune to them, Seth wants to become a Hunter and fight the Nemesis. But what Seth really wants is to find the source of all Nemesis, the Radiant. Helped by his fellow sorcerers, he will seek the Radiant, under the harsh scrutiny of the Inquisition…


---
Official Release:
- Indonesian release by Elex Media (2021)
description.fr:
Seth est un aspirant sorcier de la région des Pompo Hills. Comme tous les sorciers, c'est un " infecté " : un des rares êtres vivants ayant survécu au contact des Némésis, ces créatures tombées du ciel qui contaminent et déciment tous ceux qu'elles touchent. Son apparente immunité lui a fait choisir une voie qui lui semblait toute désignée : devenir Chasseur et combattre les Némésis.  
  
Mais plus que ça, Seth souhaite s'engager dans une quête qui dépasse la simple chasse aux monstres… Entouré d'une faction de sorciers, il parcourt le monde à la recherche du Radiant, le berceau présumé des monstres, sous l'oeil terrible de l'Inquisition…

description.ru: В мире, где на землю снизошёл гнев небес и появились мстители, человечество пытается из последних сил выжить… Как бы противно и страшно людям не было, но они вынуждены сотрудничать с существами, не менее опасными и ужасающими, чем пришельцы… С проклятыми изгоями общества, с колдунами! Сет – молодой, энергичный ученик колдуна, бравый парень, пытающийся под началом своего учителя уничтожить своего первого мстителя… Волей судьбы он находит его… или их… ДА ТУТ ЦЕЛОЕ СТАДО!!! Вперед, Сет! Вжарь им!
description.pt-br: Seth é um aprendiz de feiticeiro das colinas de Pompo. Como todos os feiticeiros, ele é um "infectado", uma das poucas pessoas que sobreviveram a um encontro com um Nêmesis, criaturas que caem do céu e destroem tudo ao seu redor. Sendo imune a eles, Seth quer se tornar um caçador e lutar contra os Nêmesis. Mas o que Seth realmente quer é encontrar a fonte dos Nemesis, o Radiant. Ajudado por seus companheiros feiticeiros, ele buscará o Radiant, sob a rigorosa caça da Inquisição contra os feiticeiros.

description.en: Mysterious incidents in a city, one after the other. A demonic being is challenged to resolve them. Sumireko, seemingly a plain store clerk, aspires to be a novelist and rocks an alluring body with some ardent admirers. Adashino, an admirer who looks like a boy, is a bookstore clerk. He's steeped in mystery however, at first, until the path of challenges is revealed that he and his sister must face in the city in order to win their ticket back home, outside this world.
description.ja: とある街で立て続けに発生する不可思議な事件。この怪異に挑むのは、地味女子でありながら無駄に色気とボディをもてあます作家志望・菫子（すみれこ）と、見た目は少年なのに妖しさ満載の謎多き化野（あだしの）の書店員コンビ。
description.ru: Ряд загадочных инцидентов начинают происходить в городе. И всё бы ничего если этот город не был домом для Сумиреко, красивой девушки с писательским стремлением. Какие же происшествия будут ждать Сумиреко и её коллегу по работе, Адашино, полного загадок парня, работающего в книжном?
description.pt-br: Uma série de acidentes misteriosos acontecem um atrás do outro na cidade. Um ser demoníaco está desafiando a todos que os resolvam. Sumireko, uma aparentemente caixa comum de loja, deseja ser uma escritora e possui um corpo voluptuoso com muitos admiradores ardentes. Adashino, um admirador que parece com um jovem garoto é o caixa de uma livraria. Ele está mergulhado em mistérios, e de repente, o caminho pra ele e sua irmã voltarem para casa (em outro mundo) aparece. Uma história moderna de romance e aspirações começa!

Chiến lược giúp nữ phản diện hoàn lương

description.en:
"Hey, Seraphina. Even when you grow up, don't end up killing me, okay?"

The wizard Arvel meets his end at the hands of his former fiancée, Seraphina, who later became the emperor's mistress and a notorious villainess. However, when he comes to, he finds himself face-to-face with a young Seraphina! Astonishingly, he has returned to being his 13-year-old self. Seeing Seraphina before she became a villainess, Arvel makes a resolution: he will raise her to become a proper person and save his own life.

To start, he begins searching for a way to prevent the death of his brother, Sho, who was once engaged to Seraphina. However, the situation is far from simple, as he must contend with Seraphina's neglectful family, men vying for the beautiful Seraphina's attention, and a web of conflicting intentions. In this journey through time, can Arvel alter Seraphina's fate and save her from becoming a villainess...!?
description.ja: 魔法使いアーヴェルは帝国一の悪女・セラフィナの手によって命を落とした・・・はずだった。何故か過去に戻ったアーヴェルは幼き日のセラフィナと対面、彼女を真っ当に育てて未来を変えると決意する＿＿。

altTitles.ja: ドリーム☆ジャンボ☆ガール

description.en: Chie is an ordinary high school girl who is doing her best to study to secure a nice life for herself. Her best friend Kana agrees and decides to help secure a bright future for Chie by buying 100 lottery tickets. But as it turns out, one hit the grand prize? What will these two girls do when they have 700 million yen (approx. $4 million) to their name?
description.ja: 将来の不安を無くすために東大を目指す高校生の千恵と、ちょっぴりおバカな叶。ある日、叶が千恵へのプレゼントに購入した宝くじが1等に見事当せん！その額なんと７億円！？突如として大金を手にしたプレッシャーから、千恵は受験に失敗してしまう…！（叶はそもそも受け忘れた。）こうなりゃヤケだ！！大金を元手に最高に楽しい人生を送ってやる！！！

description.en:
Jiro Matsuzawa is an ordinary elementary school boy. One night, an old man comes in with a trunk, containing two smaller trunks. The old man presents one to Jiro, and Jiro is permitted to have Burunga take on whatever form he wishes him to. Jiro finds Burunga to be a bit of a handful, but with the help of Taro Katagiri, a young ruffian who has his own agenda for Burunga, he manages to keep Burunga under control. However, Burunga's purpose, as well as the identity of that old man, are more sinister than Jiro could have expected...

---
**Volumes 169 and 170 of the Osamu Tezuka Complete Works**

Nako is a reserved, shy high school girl whose boyfriend is a popular, refreshingly handsome guy. Nako becomes self-belittling due to the negative comments surrounding her, and for some reason, one of the "famous" Midou siblings, Shinobu Midou, decides to give her a makeover.

Rinko Isumi, seventeen years old. Occupation: rookie mercenary.

Rinko, who applied to a private military company thinking of it as just a part-time job, finds herself thrown into a conflict zone in a foreign country alongside Nagisa, a veteran mercenary.
In a place where she has no sense of the terrain and the language and culture are foreign to her, Rinko learns everything from Nagisa and gradually learns how to “survive in this place”—.
description.ja:
伊澄凛子、十七歳。職業は――新人傭兵。

バイト感覚で民間軍事会社に応募した凛子ははベテラン傭兵の渚と共に異国の紛争地帯に放り込まれる。
土地勘もなく言葉も文化も異なる地で、凛子は全てを渚に全てを教わり“この場所で生きる”ことを学んでいく――。

『義妹生活』の三河ごーすとと期待の新鋭・坂南加が描く、戦場を舞台にした〝姉妹〟の物語。
